name: What kind of storm damage to siding is common in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What kind of storm damage to siding is common in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Storm damage to siding in the Bay Area, including Pacifica and Daly City, often involves issues caused by high winds, heavy rainfall, and occasional hail. Strong winds can loosen or tear off siding panels, especially if they were previously compromised or improperly installed. Heavy rains can lead to moisture intrusion behind the siding, potentially causing rot, mold, or structural damage if the water barrier is breached. Hail, though less frequent, can cause dents, cracks, or punctures, particularly in softer siding materials. These types of damage can compromise your home's protection and curb appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common storm damage to siding in the Bay Area includes issues from high winds, heavy rainfall, and occasional hail, leading to loosened panels, moisture intrusion, or physical damage.
